limitations: All observed native lives including dead without useful weapons and right-censored lives are retained; transient unsampled lives are not proved absent.
Inventory two-read verification is not atomic. Raw first state and first damage are not qualified.
Driver tick/20, server game_tick and wall-clock elapsed are different clocks. The selected continuation has corresponding sampled clock brackets, not an exact per-action server snapshot.
Registry membership is not a Bouncer-class assertion; actual original function calls and velocity changes are not automatically successful navigation.
One-meter residence does not detect moving loops; resource endpoints are not peak RSS or causal instrumentation overhead.
No runtime or hook was launched by this analysis; preserved post-close logs were inspected.
